content:
A little public apology 🥹

First of all, I’m genuinely so grateful for all the connection requests and DMs I’ve been receiving lately. It honestly means a lot. ❤️

But… there’s a small problem. My LinkedIn DMs literally hang most of the time.

I’ve received alot of requests in the last couple of days and have already accepted 100+, but there are still quite a few pending. I’m trying my best to get through all of them.

And to everyone who has messaged me I genuinely want to connect and reply to each one of you, but with work + MoneyHead + the overflowing inbox, it’s taking me some time. 

So, if you genuinely want to reach me, let’s make it easier.
📩 For me: harshitabagga5@gmail.com
📩 For MoneyHead-related queries: info@moneyhead.in 

I promise I’m much more likely to see and respond to an email as soon as possible.
I’ll keep accepting the pending requests, but please give me a little time. ❤️

Thank you for all the love. 🫶
Let’s connect. Let’s grow. 🚀

comment: Managing a growing network is also about building systems, not just responding faster. Clear channels for different conversations can help maintain genuine connections as visibility scales.
